## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `make fmt-check`
- [ ] `make vet`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make test-race`
- [ ] `make lint`

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Public API changes include appropriate GoDoc.
- [ ] Sensitive values are not logged, formatted, or exposed in errors.
- [ ] User-facing changes are recorded under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
